backup_saved: Backup file saved. On a new phone, use Restore from file here to bring it back.
backup_web_file_hint: Save a copy to Files, or restore one from either ForgeQuest app.
drive_web_hint: Backs up when you open the app and after each workout, to a hidden app folder in your Drive. Nothing else in your Drive is touched. Android and web share the same backup.
drive_web_nothing_to_back_up: Nothing on this phone yet, so your Drive backup was kept as it is.
pf_web_bodyfat_hint: Leave at 0 unless you have a DEXA or caliper reading. Smart scales can be off by 5–8 %.
pf_web_floor_hint: The lowest target the app allows for you is {1} kcal.
pf_web_suggested: Suggested {1} kcal from your weight, height, age, normal day ({3}) and {2} training days a week
profile_web_key_body: Get a free key from Google AI Studio, then paste it here. It stays in this browser on this phone and is only sent to Google.
coach_model_auto_hint: Recommended. Quick replies, and it switches model when one is busy
coach_model_pro_hint: Can take a minute, often no free quota
groq_key_off: Not set · makes coach replies much faster
groq_key_on: Connected · coach chat replies through Groq
groq_key_saved: Groq key saved. Chat now answers through Groq.
profile_hand_hint: Helps portion estimates when your hand is in the photo
